cards.ex: The house has a quirky layout with rooms on different levels, which some people find charming.
cards.exUz: Uyning ichki tuzilishi g'alati, xonalar har xil darajalarda joylashgan, bu ba'zilarga yoqadi.
cards.uzDef: Uyning ichki tuzilishi odatiy emas, qiziqarli, lekin ba'zan noqulay.

cards.ex: Property prices in this sought-after area are constantly rising.
cards.exUz: Bu qimmatbaho hududdagi uy-joy narxlari doimiy ravishda o'sib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning ko'pchilik yashashni xohlaydigan, qulay va qimmat hududi.

cards.ex: Our neighbor's house has been on the market for months, but no one's made an offer.
cards.exUz: Qo'shnimizning uyi bir necha oydan beri sotuvda, lekin hech kim taklif qilgani yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Uy yoki mulk sotuvga qo'yilganligi, sotilayotganligi.

cards.ex: The landlord refused to foot the bill for the repairs, so we had to pay ourselves.
cards.exUz: Uy egasi ta'mirlash xarajatlarini to'lashdan bosh tortdi, shuning uchun o'zimiz to'lashimizga to'g'ri keldi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir xarajatlarini to'liq to'lash, mas'uliyatni o'z zimmasiga olish.

cards.ex: She's very house-proud and always keeps everything spotless.
cards.exUz: U o'z uyiga juda g'amxo'r va har doim hamma narsani toza saqlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Uyi toza va tartibli bo'lishiga katta e'tibor beradigan odam.

cards.ex: They were delighted to finally be mortgage-free after 25 years.
cards.exUz: Ular 25 yildan keyin nihoyat ipotekasiz bo'lganliklaridan xursand edilar.
cards.uzDef: Uy uchun ipoteka to'lovlarini to'liq to'lab bo'lgan.

cards.ex: The hotel offered spacious accommodation with beautiful views of the sea.
cards.exUz: Mehmonxona dengizning go'zal manzaralariga ega bo'lgan keng xonalarni taklif qildi.
cards.uzDef: Katta, qulay, yetarli joyga ega turar joy.

cards.ex: The new restaurant is in a prime location, right in the city center.
cards.exUz: Yangi restoran shahar markazida, eng yaxshi joyda joylashgan.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning eng qulay, markaziy yoki yaxshi joylashgan hududi.

cards.ex: The high tenant turnover in that apartment building is a sign of poor management.
cards.exUz: O'sha ko'p qavatli uyda ijarachilarning tez-tez almashinuvi yomon boshqaruv belgisidir.
cards.uzDef: Ijarachilarning uy-joydan tez-tez ko'chib ketishi va yangilarining kelishi.

cards.ex: We decided to rent out our spare room to students to earn some extra income.
cards.exUz: Biz qo'shimcha daromad olish uchun bo'sh xonamizni talabalarga ijaraga berishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: O'z mulkini pul evaziga vaqtinchalik foydalanishga berish.

cards.ex: We had to tighten our belts when interest rates on our mortgage went up.
cards.exUz: Ipoteka foiz stavkalari oshganda, pulni tejashga majbur bo'ldik.
cards.uzDef: Pulni tejash, xarajatlarni kamaytirish, qiyinchilikka tayyorlanish.

cards.ex: It's definitely a buyer's market right now, with so many houses for sale.
cards.exUz: Hozir bozorda sotiladigan uylar ko'p bo'lgani uchun xaridorlar uchun qulay vaqt.
cards.uzDef: Uy-joy taklifi ko'p, narxlar past, xaridor uchun qulay bozor.

cards.ex: In a seller's market, you can often get more than your asking price.
cards.exUz: Sotuvchi bozorida ko'pincha so'ragan narxingizdan ko'proq pul olishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Uy-joy taklifi kam, narxlar yuqori, sotuvchi uchun qulay bozor.

cards.ex: They say location is everything when it comes to real estate, and it's true.
cards.exUz: Ular uy-joy masalasida joylashuv muhim deyishadi, va bu rost.
cards.uzDef: Uy-joy narxini belgilovchi eng muhim omil - joylashuvi.

cards.ex: Investing in bricks-and-mortar is often seen as a safer option than stocks.
cards.exUz: G'isht va tsementga sarmoya kiritish ko'pincha aktsiyalarga qaraganda xavfsizroq variant sifatida qaraladi.
cards.uzDef: Real, fizik uy-joy, biznesning virtual emasligi, haqiqiy bino.

cards.ex: The houses in this affluent neighborhood are incredibly expensive.
cards.exUz: Bu badavlat qo'shnichilikdagi uylar juda qimmat.
cards.uzDef: Boy, badavlat odamlar yashaydigan hudud.

cards.ex: The building was in a state of disrepair after years of neglect.
cards.exUz: Bino yillar davomida qarovsiz qolganidan keyin ta'mirga muhtoj edi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon holatda, ta'mirlashni talab qiladigan, qarovsiz qolgan.

cards.ex: We had to take out a large mortgage to afford our dream house.
cards.exUz: Orzudagi uyimizni sotib olish uchun katta ipoteka olishimizga to'g'ri keldi.
cards.uzDef: Uy sotib olish uchun bankdan kredit olish.

cards.ex: That coastal town is becoming a property hotspot, attracting investors from all over.
cards.exUz: Bu sohil shaharchasi butun dunyodan investorlarni jalb qiladigan mulk markaziga aylanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Uy-joy narxlari tez o'sib borayotgan mashhur hudud.

cards.ex: We need more living space now that the kids are getting older.
cards.exUz: Bolalar ulg'ayganligi sababli bizga ko'proq yashash maydoni kerak.
cards.uzDef: Uyning ichidagi yashash uchun ishlatiladigan xonalar, maydon.

cards.ex: They're planning to renovate the property and add a new bathroom.
cards.exUz: Ular mulkni ta'mirlash va yangi hammom qo'shishni rejalashtirishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Uy yoki binoni yangilash, tuzatish, yaxshilash.

cards.ex: The rental market is very competitive in the city center.
cards.exUz: Shahar markazida ijara bozori juda raqobatbardosh.
cards.uzDef: Ijaraga beriladigan uy-joylar bozoridagi vaziyat.

cards.ex: This neighborhood has become a highly desirable residence for young professionals.
cards.exUz: Bu mahalla yosh mutaxassislar uchun juda istalgan joyga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'pchilik yashashni xohlaydigan, qulay va obro'li joy.

cards.ex: We renovated our kitchen on a shoestring budget using recycled materials.
cards.exUz: Biz oshxonamizni qayta ishlangan materiallardan foydalanib, cheklangan byudjet bilan ta'mirladik.
cards.uzDef: Juda kam pulga, cheklangan byudjet bilan.

cards.ex: Buying property in that area proved to be a lucrative investment.
cards.exUz: Bu hududdan mulk sotib olish foydali sarmoya bo'lib chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p foyda keltiradigan sarmoya.

cards.ex: We had a property survey done before buying the house.
cards.exUz: Biz uyni sotib olishdan oldin mulkni tekshirishni o'tkazdik.
cards.uzDef: Uyning holatini tekshirish va hisobot berish.

cards.ex: Even with the rise of online shopping, many people still prefer bricks-and-mortar businesses.
cards.exUz: Onlayn xaridlar ko'payishiga qaramay, ko'pchilik hali ham jismoniy do'konlarni afzal ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Onlayn emas, balki jismoniy do'koni mavjud biznes.

cards.ex: They bought a beautiful period property with original features.
cards.exUz: Ular o'ziga xos xususiyatlarga ega bo'lgan chiroyli tarixiy mulkni sotib olishdi.
cards.uzDef: Eski, tarixiy ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan uy yoki bino.

cards.ex: Our mortgage application was approved yesterday!
cards.exUz: Ipoteka arizamiz kecha tasdiqlandi!
cards.uzDef: Ipoteka olish uchun bankka beriladigan ariza.

cards.ex: The garden is a real asset of this well-maintained property.
cards.exUz: Bog' bu yaxshi saqlangan mulkning haqiqiy boyligi.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi holatda saqlangan uy yoki bino.
